text:
anya: Running the sampleapp smoke with 40 parallel users exposed a nasty UX regression. Pagination stalls for ~2-3s then dumps 8 requests at once. Seems like limiter + pagination + retries are interacting badly.

rob: Which SDK? Is this on the quickstart JS example or the production lib?

anya: Quickstart JS example, but I can repro with the SDK linked locally. Steps: start sampleapp --concurrency=40 --pages=8 --embed-load=heavy.

kevin: Logs from the client during repro:
```
INFO limiter: acquired permit (route=/v1/search) inflight=95
DEBUG paginator: waiting for permit to fetch page=3
WARN auth: refresh requested while inflight=120
INFO retry: immediate retry (attempt=1) bypassed-limiter=true
ERROR api: 403 token invalid (transient)
```

maria: Ah the "bypassed-limiter=true" is suspicious. That indicates our retry path currently ignores client limiter and retries immediately. That will cause bursts once the token refresh completes.

kevin: The JS SDK implements a global leaky-bucket with a single window. Go SDK has per-endpoint semaphores. We probably lost parity in the new v2 paginator changes.

anya: Also, the paginator holds the cursor while waiting for the permit, which blocks other cursors from advancing in the same process. If an embed call is hogging permits, the search cursors pile up.

rob: Two quick mitigations while we fix: 1) disable bypass on auth retry; 2) change sampleapp to create separate SDK client instances per logical route so they don't compete for the same limiter. Not ideal but quick.

kevin: Long term plan:
- make limiter scope configurable (scope:global|per-client|per-route)
- ensure all retry paths go through limiter.acquire() (including auth refresh retry)
- change paginator to do non-blocking prefetch: return current page while fetching next in background

maria: I'm +1. Also add singleflight for token refresh at SDK auth layer so concurrent requests share the same refresh promise instead of issuing N refreshes.

kevin: Implementation notes: singleflight as a Map<cacheKey,Promise>. On refresh start, store promise; other callers await same promise; finally delete from map. Edge cases: failed refresh should clear cache and surface error. Add TTL slightly less than token expiry to avoid repeat refresh storms.

rob: Tests: add an integration that spins up sampleapp with mixed routes and asserts no >3s stall and no spike of 5xx auth errors. Also add unit tests for retry path to ensure bypass flag is never set.

ci-cd-bot: FYI: create issue area/devex, label priority/high if customer-impacting, add e2e/test-flaky tag.

anya: I'll open a draft PR: feat/devex/route-scoped-limiter + test harness. Will include a sampleapp flag to toggle PREFETCH=true.

maria: I'll take the auth singleflight work. plan branch: fix/auth-singleflight-js.

kevin: I'll align the paginator and add a config to control whether cursor is held. Also will add telemetry: metric client.limiter.scope and metric auth.refresh.concurrent_count.

rob: Cool. Let's ship behind flags and roll out to canary. Keep me posted. :raised_hands:
